name: Arizona 29-card Pitch
description: Arizona 29-card Pitch is a specialized regional evolution of the classic American game Pitch (Setback). It uses a condensed 29-card deck and incorporates an unbeatable Joker into the trump hierarchy. Played in partnerships, it rewards both the capture of legendary cards (High, Low, Jack) and the strategic management of a 5-card kitty.

content.text: Arizona 29-card Pitch is a specialized regional evolution of the classic American game Pitch (Setback). It uses a condensed 29-card deck and incorporates an unbeatable Joker into the trump hierarchy. Played in partnerships, it rewards both the capture of legendary cards (High, Low, Jack) and the strategic management of a 5-card kitty.
Developed in the Southwestern United States as a faster, more intense version of the standard 52-card Partnership Pitch. The use of the '6' as the low card instead of the '2' is a regional hallmark.
4 players in two partnerships (North-South vs East-West).
29 cards: Ace, King, Queen, Jack, Ten, Nine, Six of each suit, plus one Joker. Remove 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, and 8 from a standard deck.
Each player is dealt 6 cards in batches of 3. The 5 remaining cards are placed face down as the 'Kitty'.

items.text: Standard Partnership Pitch: Played with the full 52-card deck (minus Joker). High to Low is A to 2.
Flat Pitch: No kitty is dealt; players play only with the 6 cards originally dealt.
